people.name: Daesung Lee
people.title: Professor
people.bio: Professor, Dept. of Maritime AI & Cyber Security. Director, Cybersecurity Engineering Research Center. Leads the Next-Generation Convergence Security Lab (Room 903, Sanhak Hub Bldg.). Research interests: AX Security, Convergence Security, Network Security, Maritime Cybersecurity, ICS Security, Critical Information Infrastructure Protection.
people.cv:
Education
- Ph.D. in Information Engineering, Inha University (2008)
- M.S. in Electronic Computer Engineering, Inha University (2001)
- B.S. in Electronic Computer Engineering, Inha University (1999)

Career
- Professor, Korea Maritime & Ocean University (2024–present)
- Director, Cybersecurity Engineering Research Center (2024–present)
- Director, Maritime AX Talent Bootcamp Program (2026–present)
- President, Korea Institute of Information and Communication Engineering (2025–present)
- Director, Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Regional University White-Hat Hacker Training Program (2020–present)

Research Interests
- AX Security, Convergence Security, Network Security
- Maritime Cybersecurity
- Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Security
- Critical Information Infrastructure Protection
